# Transgenerational plasticity in temperate sea urchins -- maternal effects mediate the physiological effects of increased temperature and acidification 

Temperature is the most important stressor in determining urchin survival (chapter 2), regardless of pH (chapter 3). However, long term experiments aside, there is a need to understand transgen effects.

In this chapter we used spawned urchins.
